CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lf_line (
  code VARCHAR(32) PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
  stage INTEGER NOT NULL,
  sequence INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lf_buffer (
  code VARCHAR(32) PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
  role VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lf_article (
  sku VARCHAR(32) PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
  kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lf_article_line (
  sku VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  line_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (sku, line_code)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lf_dependency (
  id VARCHAR(40) PRIMARY KEY,
  sku VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  consumer_line VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  material_sku VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  qty_per_m2 DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
  buffer_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lf_sales_order (
  order_no VARCHAR(32) PRIMARY KEY,
  sku VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  qty_m2 DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
  priority INTEGER NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  due_date DATE NOT NULL,
  source VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lf_schedule (
  order_no VARCHAR(32) PRIMARY KEY,
  sku VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  line_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  start_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  end_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lf_material_need (
  id VARCHAR(40) PRIMARY KEY,
  order_no VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  material_sku VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  qty_m2 DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
  buffer_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lf_wms_command (
  id VARCHAR(40) PRIMARY KEY,
  order_no VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  command_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  material_sku VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  qty_m2 DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
  target VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL
);

source.body: {"steps": [{"type": "selectMany", "var": "rows", "sql": "SELECT s.order_no, s.sku, l.name AS line_name, s.line_code, s.status FROM lf_schedule s JOIN lf_line l ON l.code = s.line_code ORDER BY s.start_at"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "slot", "sql": "SELECT order_no, sku, line_code FROM lf_schedule WHERE order_no = ?", "params": ["${input.orderNo}"]}, {"type": "failIfNull", "var": "slot", "message": "Заказ не найден на доске"}, {"type": "selectOne", "var": "cap", "sql": "SELECT line_code FROM lf_article_line WHERE sku = ? AND line_code = ?", "params": ["${slot.sku}", "${input.lineCode}"]}, {"type": "failIfNull", "var": "cap", "message": "Артикул нельзя выпускать на этой линии"}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE lf_schedule SET line_code = ?, start_at = ?::timestamptz, end_at = ?::timestamptz, status = 'replanned' WHERE order_no = ?", "params": ["${input.lineCode}", "${input.startAt}", "${input.endAt}", "${input.orderNo}"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "DELETE FROM lf_material_need WHERE order_no = ?", "params": ["${input.orderNo}"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "DELETE FROM lf_wms_command WHERE order_no = ?", "params": ["${input.orderNo}"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO lf_material_need (id, order_no, material_sku, qty_m2, buffer_code) SELECT 'need-' || s.order_no || '-' || d.material_sku, s.order_no, d.material_sku, o.qty_m2 * d.qty_per_m2, d.buffer_code FROM lf_schedule s JOIN lf_sales_order o ON o.order_no = s.order_no JOIN lf_dependency d ON d.sku = s.sku AND d.consumer_line = s.line_code WHERE s.order_no = ?", "params": ["${input.orderNo}"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO lf_wms_command (id, order_no, command_type, material_sku, qty_m2, target, status) SELECT 'wms-' || n.order_no || '-' || n.material_sku, n.order_no, 'FEED_LINE', n.material_sku, n.qty_m2, l.name, 'queued' FROM lf_material_need n JOIN lf_schedule s ON s.order_no = n.order_no JOIN lf_line l ON l.code = s.line_code WHERE n.order_no = ?", "params": ["${input.orderNo}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "orderNo": "${input.orderNo}", "lineCode": "${input.lineCode}", "status": "replanned"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE lf_dispatch_job SET state = 'released' WHERE order_no = ? AND state = 'queued'", "params": ["${input.orderNo}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "orderNo": "${input.orderNo}", "state": "released"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE lf_quality_lot SET state = ?, note = ? WHERE lot_id = ?", "params": ["${input.state}", "${input.note}", "${input.lotId}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "lotId": "${input.lotId}", "state": "${input.state}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "ord", "sql": "SELECT order_no, qty_m2, priority, status FROM lf_sales_order WHERE order_no = ?", "params": ["${input.orderNo}"]}, {"type": "failIfNull", "var": "ord", "message": "Заказ SAP не найден"}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE lf_sales_order SET status = CASE WHEN ? = 'cancel' THEN 'cancelled' ELSE status END, priority = CASE WHEN ? = 'priority' THEN ?::integer ELSE priority END, qty_m2 = CASE WHEN ? = 'qty' THEN ?::double precision ELSE qty_m2 END WHERE order_no = ?", "params": ["${input.action}", "${input.action}", "${input.value}", "${input.action}", "${input.value}", "${input.orderNo}"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE lf_schedule SET status = CASE WHEN ? = 'cancel' THEN 'cancelled' ELSE status END WHERE order_no = ?", "params": ["${input.action}", "${input.orderNo}"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "DELETE FROM lf_material_need WHERE order_no = ? AND ? = 'cancel'", "params": ["${input.orderNo}", "${input.action}"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE lf_wms_command SET status = 'CANCEL' WHERE order_no = ? AND ? = 'cancel'", "params": ["${input.orderNo}", "${input.action}"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "DELETE FROM lf_material_need WHERE order_no = ? AND ? = 'qty'", "params": ["${input.orderNo}", "${input.action}"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO lf_material_need (id, order_no, material_sku, qty_m2, buffer_code) SELECT 'need-' || s.order_no || '-' || d.material_sku, s.order_no, d.material_sku, o.qty_m2 * d.qty_per_m2, d.buffer_code FROM lf_schedule s JOIN lf_sales_order o ON o.order_no = s.order_no JOIN lf_dependency d ON d.sku = s.sku AND d.consumer_line = s.line_code WHERE s.order_no = ? AND ? = 'qty'", "params": ["${input.orderNo}", "${input.action}"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "DELETE FROM lf_wms_command WHERE order_no = ? AND ? = 'qty'", "params": ["${input.orderNo}", "${input.action}"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO lf_wms_command (id, order_no, command_type, material_sku, qty_m2, target, status) SELECT 'wms-' || n.order_no || '-' || n.material_sku, n.order_no, 'FEED_LINE', n.material_sku, n.qty_m2, l.name, 'queued' FROM lf_material_need n JOIN lf_schedule s ON s.order_no = n.order_no JOIN lf_line l ON l.code = s.line_code WHERE n.order_no = ? AND ? = 'qty'", "params": ["${input.orderNo}", "${input.action}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "orderNo": "${input.orderNo}", "status": "${input.action}"}}]}
